excerpt.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
excerpt.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

texts.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
texts.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

sections.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

texts.zh: 一个微奇点最近与[From.GetName]相交，径直穿过核心到达了另一边的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。这次遭遇似乎并没有造成永久性的损害，但稍微改变了行星核心的能源输出，这一点与我们目前的科学模型相违背。需要进行更深入的研究。
texts.en: A microsingularity recently intersected [From.GetName], passing straight through the core and emerging on the other side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. The encounter does not seem to have caused any permanent damage, but it has altered the energy output of the planetary core slightly in a way that defies our current scientific models. Further study may be warranted.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在被[Root.GetName]观测时自身的磁场出现了完全的反转。这个罕见的现象也因此改变了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的磁极位置。幸亏这些都被我们的传感器记录了下来，给科学家们提供了宝贵的数据。
texts.en: The magnetic field of [From.GetName] experienced a complete reversal while it was being observed by the [Root.GetName]. This rare event has interchanged the positions of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic poles. Fortunately, it was all recorded by the sensors of our ship, providing our scientists with a lot of valuable data.

texts.zh: 在接近[From.GetName]时，几枚质量加速炮弹从[Root.GetName]的船侧飞驰而过。这些投射物已经有数十亿年的历史了，从轨迹判断，它们似乎是从邻近星系发射的，在偏离原定目标继续默默的飞行了许久-直到今天你看到它们。尽管历史悠久，但我们回收的这些炮弹的设计还是非常尖端的。
texts.en: While approaching [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suddenly received a glancing hit by several passing mass driver rounds. The projectiles were billions of years old, and based on their trajectory they appear to be stray rounds fired from a neighboring galaxy. After missing their intended target, they continued on their journey for untold millennia - until today. The rounds we have recovered are of an advanced design despite their incredible age.

texts.zh:
我们追踪[From.GetName]上散发的异常电磁辐射的来源，发现了一座地下碉堡，里面藏着一台足有一艘战列舰那么大的超级电脑。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]怀疑它可能已经在那存在了上千年，一直都在努力解决一个非常复杂的问题，而其本质仍不明确。

当试着与电脑互动时，他们发现那座似乎被废弃且不设防的设施，事实上受到一个保安人工智能的控制，其最高目的似乎就是将访客烧焦。在终于击败了人工智能之后，它向未知接收者发送了一条信息。
texts.en:
We have traced the unusual electromagnetic radiation emanating from [From.GetName] to a secret subterranean bunker hiding a mega-computer the size of a battleship.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] suspect that it may have been there for several thousand years, hard at work solving a single very complex problem, the nature of which still eludes us.

When attempting to interact with the computer they discovered that the facility, which had appeared both abandoned and unguarded, was in fact operated by a security AI, the highest purpose of which seems to be frying its visitors with extreme prejudice. When the AI was finally defeated, it broadcasted a message to an unknown recipient.

label.zh: 把超级电脑拆了当零件！

tooltips.zh: 一台花了上千年都没能解决一个问题的电脑，最好还是拿来造成船壳吧……
tooltips.en: A computer that has failed to solve a single problem in a thousand years will serve us better as a new ship hull...

label.zh: 用它来强化我们自己的科研……
label.en: Use it to boost our own research...

tooltips.zh: 这需要关闭维持设施的人工智能，并将导致电脑在可预见的未来崩溃。
tooltips.en: This requires that we keep the AI maintaining the facility offline and will cause the computer to break down within a foreseeable future.

label.zh: 让它继续那神秘的计算……
label.en: Let it continue its mysterious calculations...

tooltips.zh: 我们最好不要打扰它。不管那电脑在尝试解决什么问题，看起来都挺重要的……
tooltips.en: We had better not disturb it. Whatever problem the computer is trying to solve, it seems important...
